name: Pitztaler Nachtigall
beschreibung: The family-run Apart Hotel Pitztaler Nachtigall is located in Oberleins, a village in the municipality of Arzl im Pitztal in the Tyrolean Pitz Valley. The house offers nine apartments for up to eight people, each holiday apartment with its own balcony or terrace. Facilities include a sauna with relaxation room, a large sun terrace, a lounge with bar, a reading corner and an indoor games room with table tennis, table football, billiards and darts. There is also a private parking space, a sunbathing lawn with a small playground and the option of bringing pets along. Right outside the door, an hourly free ski bus takes guests to the valley station of the Hochzeiger Bergbahnen in about a quarter of an hour; a free ski depot is available at our partner business Sport Lentsch. In summer, the hiking bus runs. On prior request, fresh bread rolls from the bakery are delivered to the house daily. Arrival and booking are arranged directly with the Deutschmann family.
